notes: Low-rate bulk collection: one brand index call, one public brand page per brand, and one config page per series. 2 workers overlap network waits, while each worker waits DELAY*CONCURRENCY so the aggregate theoretical request rate does not exceed the former sequential pacing. No IP spoofing, CAPTCHA bypass, account use, or high-rate spec-by-spec requests.

Only variants with an explicit model year 2020+ are retained; a historical series is not added to the China model denominator unless at least one retained 2020+ variant proves it intersects the required window.
